reasoning_content: It seems all puma processes have been stopped (the awk output was empty, and the grep -c "[p]uma" showing 2 is probably from the grep subshell itself or a leftover). Let me cleanly verify the final state: check whether the server is still listening, and reconfirm the main evidence of the installation. Also, let me double-check that PostgreSQL and memcached are still running (these should be kept running for the final state).

action.command:
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "3000|3001|5432|11211" | awk '{print $4}'; echo "=== postgres ==="; su postgres -c "psql -t -c 'select 1;'" 2>&1 | head -2; echo "=== memcached ==="; python3 -c "
import socket
s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',11211),3)
s.sendall(b'version\r\n'); print(s.recv(64).decode().strip()); s.close()" 2>&1
